description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ginipendegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurnegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420911
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels in Ginipendegama and Moragollagama villages. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, cadastral map references, ownership details, and land extent measurements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
